researchNotes: lattafa.com returned HTTP 403 to every request (products.json, llms.txt, product pages), so the brand's regional Shopify site lattafaindia.com was used: products.json readable (first ~1.2 MB of feed scanned by listing only, product pages opened for each entry). All notes are from official product pages (noteSource official), recorded as top/heart/base as the page labels them. Concentration recorded only where the page states EDP/EDT/Parfum; names like 'Elixir' alone are not treated as a concentration. Years only where the page text states a launch year (Hayaati Gold Elixir 2023, Jasoor 2023, Najdia Tribute 2021). Deodorants, body sprays, hair mists, discovery sets, gift sets, minis, home fragrance and Pride/Niche sub-lines beyond Pride Art of Arabia I were skipped or not reached; the Lattafa catalogue is larger than this list (the feed was not read to the end). Teriaq, Badee Al Oud and Khamrah (base) were not found in the parts of the feed read and are not included. Brand country not stated on any page read.

fragrances.name: Khamrah Waha
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review scores it about 3.5/5 longevity and 3.0/5 sillage, moderate projection, 'not a powerhouse'; another reviewer calls it long lasting for a summer scent; Parfumo averages ~7/10.

fragrances.name: Yara

sources.name: Fragplace — Yara by Lattafa Perfumes FAQ

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summary of several pages: most reviews put longevity near 4-6 h (retailer pages claim 8-10 h), sillage moderate and front-loaded over the first 2-3 hours.

fragrances.name: Fahad
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir reviews rate longevity 3.5-4/5 and sillage 3/5 (loud ~2 h then skin scent, longevity called the weak point, varies by skin); Parfumo averages ~7.3/10 for both.

fragrances.name: Mashrabya

sources.name: Fragplace — Mashrabya by Lattafa Perfumes FAQ

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace/aggregators: longevity typically 6-10 h; sillage described as moderate to strong; a Malaysian retailer says 6-8 h; performs best in cooler weather.

fragrances.name: Asad Elixir
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir and a Parfumo reviewer report 8-10 h on skin, Jameela (Malaysian retailer) says 6-8 h; sillage described as strong; reviewers suggest cooler weather and evenings.

fragrances.name: Sheikh Al Shuyukh Supreme

sources.name: Lattafa India - Sheikh Al Shuyukh Supreme
Lattafa Malaysia — Sheikh Al Shuyukh Supreme longevity and projection test

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Lattafa Malaysia blog: up to 8 h with moderate projection, suited to evenings/special occasions; other retailers say 8-10 h with moderate-to-strong sillage; ScentVerdict lists 6-10 h.

fragrances.name: Yara Elixir

sources.name: Lattafa Malaysia — Yara Elixir longevity and projection test

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailer listings give 6-8 h (one 4-8 h) and moderate-to-strong sillage that settles close to skin; Vivir scores about 3.8 longevity and 3.5 sillage out of 5.

fragrances.name: Yara Tous

sources.name: Dupe.com — The best Lattafa Yara perfume

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir gives 4.0/5 longevity and 3.0/5 sillage; Dupe.com claims 8-10 h on skin with the softest sillage of the Yara line; Parfumo averages about 7/10 for both.

fragrances.name: Nasmaat
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: longevity 4.0/5, sillage 3.0/5; FragranceX listing claims 8-12 h on skin; retailer copy describes balanced projection.

fragrances.name: Layaan

sources.name: Lattafa Malaysia — Layaan longevity and projection test

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Lattafa Malaysia test: roughly 6-8 h on skin, soft to moderate projection of about 2-3 feet; Malaysian retailer says the same 6-8 h.

fragrances.name: Ameer Al Arab Imperium

sources.name: Lattafa India - Ameer Al Arab Imperium

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailer listings (Jameela, Lattafa Malaysia and others) give roughly 6-8 h and moderate projection; one source says it shines in fall and winter.

fragrances.name: Ana Abiyedh Scarlet
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailer listings give 6-8 h with moderate-to-strong sillage (one claims 8-12 h); a Parfumo reviewer reports about 8 h on skin, longer on clothing.

fragrances.name: Dynasty

sources.name: Beauty Booth Qatar — Lattafa Dynasty EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Reviewers report about 8-9 h on skin and up to next day on clothing, projection varies from close to skin to above average; one listing claims 7-9 h with strong sillage.

fragrances.name: Khamrah Dukhan
fragrances.performanceEvidence: A Parfumo reviewer finds 6-9 h on skin with above-average sillage, another rates longevity 10/10 and sillage 8/10; a retailer lists sillage as moderate to strong.

fragrances.name: Qaa'ed
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume.com says the EDP typically lasts 8-12 h, Vivir about 6-8 h with moderate projection (arm's length for 2-3 h); Parfumo averages about 8/10 for both.

Fragplace — Qaed Al Fursan Unlimited FAQ

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume.com lists about 6-8 h; Jameela says long-lasting with moderate, noticeable sillage; a Parfumo reviewer gives 8/10 longevity and 7/10 sillage, another calls it weak.

fragrances.name: Velvet Oud

sources.name: Lattafa Malaysia — Velvet Oud longevity and projection test

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Lattafa Malaysia blog: 8-10 h on skin with moderate projection; retailers claim 8-12 h and moderate-to-strong sillage; reviewers say it suits fall and winter; one reviewer got about 9 h.

fragrances.name: The Kingdom Man

sources.name: Fragplace — The Kingdom For Men FAQ

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace: typically 6-10 h with strong projection; Brotherhood of Scent reviewer 8-10 h, strongest in the first hour; retailers claim 7-9 h; Parfumo averages about 8/10.

fragrances.name: The Kingdom Women

sources.name: Zaoud — Lattafa The Kingdom for Women EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Lattafa Malaysia blog says 8-10 h on skin; Zaoud describes moderate sillage; Parfumo averages about 7.6/10 longevity and 7.2/10 sillage; one table lists 4-6 h.

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace: typically 6-10 h with strong, noticeable projection; Scents Angel claims 8-12 h, moderate to strong; Parfumo averages about 8.4/10 longevity and 7.9/10 sillage.

fragrances.name: Oud Mood
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 8-10 h with strong persistent sillage; another review 8-12 h; Jameela says moderate sillage; Parfumo averages about 8.5/10 longevity and 8.2/10 sillage; reviewers say it thrives in cooler weather.

fragrances.name: Her Confession
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Review pages and retailer guides give about 6-8 h (7-9 h in one guide); sillage moderate at first, softening after the first hour; Parfumo reviewers report 6-8 h.

fragrances.name: His Confession

sources.name: Lattafa Malaysia — His Confession longevity and projection test

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailers and users give 6-10 h of usable wear (one reviewer about 7 h); Lattafa blog claims 8-10 h; sillage described as moderate.

fragrances.name: Maahir Legancy

Lattafa Malaysia — Jasoor longevity and projection test
